claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
The Voyage of the City of Paris—To the Editor of the
Herald—Through an error in the Atlantic Cable despatch
the City of Paris was reported to have arrived at Queens-
town on the 7th instant, and I notice that you have so pub-
lished it in your yesterday's second edition. I now enclose
copy of the ship's log by which you will see that she ar-
rived at Liverpool on the night of the 6th[?]. She delivered her
news ahead of any of the steamers that sailed with her from
New York. Yours, JOHN G. DALE,
Per S. G. Nicholson.

Steamship Kangaroo (Br), Manning, Liverpool, July 13,
with mdse and 292 passengers, to John G Dale. July 14, 14
miles NE of Tuscar, passed ship Jeremiah Thompson, from
Liverpool for New York; 17th, steamshio[?] City of Dublin,

for do.
